about:
Prince 15.1 line breaks of justified paragraphs, measured on DocRaptor (pipeline 10, 2026-10-21; spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-pdf-quality-and-prince-compat-design.md, F8): a deterministic subset of the 1215 paragraphs measured. Synthetic text in DejaVu Sans 10pt, line-height 1.2, lang en, text-align: justify; each paragraph is width_pt wide with the extra css; prince_lines are the line texts Prince set (soft hyphens dropped, a hyphen at a hyphenated line end). Id prefixes: R narrow random, S/S2 two-line flip sweeps, W wide random, H hypothesis tests, T tolerance, E 8pt, J text-align-last: justify, Y soft hyphens, B hyphens: auto, C prose with soft hyphens, N prose without hyphenation, Q double and explicit hyphens, L long-range, Z no-break spaces, A
, I text-indent, K bold runs. xfail: known exceptions, with the reason.
